title: Detailed rain cloud
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='cloudGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b8c6e0'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#7d8fb3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5a6b8f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cloudHi' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#eef3fb'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c3cfe6'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- main cloud body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='38' ry='20' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='38' rx='18' ry='15' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='37' rx='20' ry='16' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='16' ry='13' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>

  <!-- puffy tops with lighter highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='31' rx='14' ry='11' fill='url(#cloudHi)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='30' rx='15' ry='12' fill='url(#cloudHi)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='24' rx='12' ry='10' fill='url(#cloudHi)'/>
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='38' rx='9' ry='8' fill='url(#cloudHi)'/>
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='38' rx='10' ry='8' fill='url(#cloudHi)'/>

  <!-- soft shaded underside -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='34' ry='11' fill='#4a5a7d' opacity='0.55'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='55' rx='14' ry='7' fill='#3d4b6b' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='55' rx='15' ry='7' fill='#3d4b6b' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- rain streaks -->
  <g stroke='#6fb7f0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='26' y1='62' x2='22' y2='76'/>
    <line x1='38' y1='64' x2='34' y2='80'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='63' x2='46' y2='79'/>
    <line x1='62' y1='64' x2='58' y2='80'/>
    <line x1='74' y1='62' x2='70' y2='76'/>
  </g>
  <g stroke='#a8d8ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='32' y1='66' x2='29' y2='78'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='67' x2='41' y2='81'/>
    <line x1='56' y1='67' x2='53' y2='81'/>
    <line x1='68' y1='66' x2='65' y2='78'/>
  </g>

  <!-- raindrops -->
  <g fill='#7cc4f5'>
    <ellipse cx='24' cy='84' rx='2.6' ry='3.6'/>
    <ellipse cx='36' cy='88' rx='2.6' ry='3.6'/>
    <ellipse cx='48' cy='86' rx='2.6' ry='3.6'/>
    <ellipse cx='60' cy='88' rx='2.6' ry='3.6'/>
    <ellipse cx='72' cy='84' rx='2.6' ry='3.6'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#bfe6ff'>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='93' rx='2' ry='2.8'/>
    <ellipse cx='54' cy='94' rx='2' ry='2.8'/>
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='93' rx='2' ry='2.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
